'''Erina To'nos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] requisition officer for the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
